header: Many destinations in one row that scrolls
lead: A scroll-snap track: drag it, swipe it, or tab into it and use the arrow keys. Three to twenty cards, and the row costs the page one line of height however many there are.

items.title: Scroll snap, no script
items.description: The snap points and the momentum are the browser's own.

items.title: A focus stop with a name
items.description: So a keyboard can reach the row and hear what is in it.

items.title: The scrollbar stays
items.description: It is the only thing that says there is more to the side.

items.title: The next card is half in view
items.description: Which is the other thing that says it.

items.title: One card per link
items.description: Carried by the title, so the card is the target.

items.title: Three to twenty destinations
items.description: A set that should be visible at once is a card menu.
